install_policy.cargo_config_policy: Append only the required crates-io patch if the table is absent; preserve unrelated config; refuse conflicting creusot-std patches; require the generated file to be Git-ignored.

interpretation.base_model: Opaque numeric address observer only; no pointer permission, provenance identity, or allocation liveness fact.
interpretation.capacity_model: Opaque observer keyed by actual generic Vec value; no sequence identity, pointer identity, or allocation injectivity axiom.
interpretation.pointer_model: Opaque exact mutable getter pointer observer keyed by actual Vec term; no access permission, allocation injectivity, byte contents or liveness; B1/B2 must independently supply sealed matching authority.
interpretation.termination: New extern contracts add no total-correctness attributes; existing infallible std termination check remains inherited.

package.name: creusot-std
package.provenance: Pinned normalized Cargo registry package; no workspace-relative dependencies are used.

address-model.patch.scope: Only the generic Vec numeric base-address observer contract.

alloc-capacity.patch.scope: Only the eight normalized registry-package chunks from the generic capacity and alloc exposure proposal.

pointer-model.patch.scope: Generic exact mutable Vec getter pointer observation and pointer/capacity preservation only; no permission, injectivity or liveness.

tree_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted regular files, each encoded as UTF-8 relative POSIX path + NUL + lowercase SHA-256 hex of file bytes + newline. Symlinks are rejected.
